notes: An owned private-Xvfb session captured the entire 36-case batch; no existing user session was targeted.
The response was compacted as JSON and all retained values were checked recursively against the original, including IEEE-754 numeric bit patterns.
The probe checks insertion does not mutate caller-owned input and replacement/commands do not change identity or object count.
Native command and UI tests independently exercise these behavioral witnesses. This is not an identical-source native replay or speed comparison.
Mesh SolidOrientation diagnostics remain unchanged while raw face winding reverses; the raw diagnostic and face definitions are both preserved.
Document-wide normalization of multi-shell geometry is not implemented on the basis of single-shell observations.
